# HTML&HTML — Premium HTML Templates

> Canonical site: https://htmlandhtml.com/
> Product model: premium HTML5/CSS3/Vanilla JavaScript templates
> Typical price range: USD 9–29
> Primary buyers: freelancers, small agencies, independent developers, businesses and AI-assisted builders

## What HTML&HTML sells
HTML&HTML produces original, vertical-specific website templates built with semantic HTML5, modern CSS and lightweight Vanilla JavaScript. The default product does not require React, Vue, WordPress, Shopify or another framework.

## Current catalog

- Table — Restaurant — $14
- Launchpad — AI / SaaS — $19

## Product principles
- clean source and low dependency count
- responsive design across documented viewport checks
- accessibility-aware interaction patterns
- centralized design tokens
- AI-friendly customization guidance
- commercially original implementation
- truthful verification: no performance, accessibility, browser or device claim without evidence
